Title: [LSJ] Question: Clan impersonated Horatio Ballard or Maxwell

Messages.Author: Tobias
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

It's been ruled that sabbat or independent vampires cannot become
prince(s).

However, if either Horatio Ballard or Maxwell were clan impersonated
(or deranged, or any other variant) into a sabbat or independent clan,
would they still be allowed to take their innate action to become
prince?

I presume the answer is no. But I can imagine a 'take action for no
effect' response as well.

Thanks
Tobias
(tried to find previous answer with google searches: 'horatio ballard
clan impersonation' and 'maxwell clan impersonation'.)
